note: Route-graph ratchet baseline (no-new-rot ratchet). Each entry is the CURRENT reachable-first-party-module-count ceiling for a LOCKED FIXED_ROUTES route (the primary dev-perf 'first-party graph pressure' metric from scripts/route-graph.mjs). The gate fails when a tracked route's count grows BEYOND its ceiling and when the committed baseline raises any ceiling vs the base branch WITHOUT a matching absorb record. Counts are captured WITH the companion extension repos cloned pinned (exactly as CI does via clone-extensions) so they reproduce in CI. Regenerate with `node scripts/audit/route-graph-ratchet.mjs --write-baseline` after cloning the extensions — a ceiling should only ever be LOWERED as barrel imports are narrowed, and is never raised SILENTLY. A sanctioned raise must be ANNOTATED: a sibling `absorbs` record `route -> { from, to, reason, pr }` whose from/to exactly match the raise vs the base branch (from = the base ceiling, to = the new committed ceiling, reason = why the growth is accepted, pr = the PR carrying the absorbed change). The gate validates records strictly (malformed/stale/orphan records fail closed; a carried-forward record may not be deleted while its raised ceiling is kept) and prints a LOUD NOTICE line for every absorbed raise. The tracked route set is route-graph.mjs FIXED_ROUTES; change it there, then regenerate.

/api/a2a.reason: The A2A development bypass now takes the shared local-caller decision (src/lib/local-caller-gate.ts) instead of reading the Host header, and that decision brings exactly three first-party leaves onto this route: the gate itself, the socket-peer helper (src/lib/request-peer.ts) and the boot-credential reader (src/lib/boot-credential.ts). This is the MERGE of origin/main into the branch, so `from` (1753) is main's OWN committed ceiling at 8219e14691e2a212c4478b8690b26dbe8728c8c7 — main's overlay-collision raise of cinatra#3105 (PR #3111, +2 on this route) is already inside `from` and is NOT re-absorbed here. ATTRIBUTED BY MEASUREMENT, not computed and not hand-merged: in ONE environment, with the companion extension fleet cloned PINNED (114/114, missingCount 0) and an identical scripts/route-graph.mjs, TWO trees were analysed — origin/main at 8219e14691e2a212c4478b8690b26dbe8728c8c7 measures 1753 (/api/a2a), 1763 (/api/llm-bridge), 1748 (/api/mcp) and 1849 (/chat), i.e. each of its committed ceilings EXACTLY, and this merge measures +3 on exactly the two routes the A2A bypass entry reaches (this one and /api/llm-bridge) and +0 on /api/mcp and /chat — so the whole growth is those three modules and nothing else composed onto them by main. All three are deliberately dependency-light: no barrel imports and no app graph behind them, which is why a change that hardens three separate surfaces costs three modules in total rather than three per surface. Narrowing is not available and would be the wrong trade: the alternative is a per-route copy of the local-caller decision, which is the divergence this change exists to remove. This raise RETIRES main's PR #3111 record for this route, the one lifecycle the gate allows for an annotation whose ceiling moves.

/api/mcp.reason: The overlay-collision bound of cinatra#3105 moves OUT of the design registry's `utils` item into its own module, in the host tree (src/lib/overlay-collision.ts) and in the portable tree (packages/sdk-ui/src/lib/overlay-collision.ts). src/lib/utils.ts is the published `utils` registry item: it is emitted into public/r/utils.json for outside consumers and copied byte-for-byte into every extension that vendors a design primitive, so a helper that reads `document` and the app shell's `--banner-height` had no business living there. The two panel families that take the bound (the popover and the dropdown menu, plus the select list on the host side) now import the new module, which is the whole +2: two files where there was none. ATTRIBUTED BY MEASUREMENT, not argued: in ONE environment, with the companion extension fleet cloned PINNED (114/114, missingCount 0), the same scanner on this same tree with the two modules removed and the imports folded back into `utils` measures 1751 (/api/a2a), 1761 (/api/llm-bridge), 1746 (/api/mcp) and 1847 (/chat) — each route's committed ceiling EXACTLY — and with them present measures each ceiling + 2. Narrowing is not available: the bound is one expression shared by all three panel families, and folding it back into the vendored lib is the defect this change removes.
